prompt: Character design sheet of Morgen, a 20-something courier and info-broker, front view, side view, and back view, modern Japanese anime style, 2D illustration, clean line art, flat cell shading, solid white background. Morgen has short cropped silver-white hair, bright grey eyes, and tanned skin covered in faint scar-like code patterns instead of fingerprints. Wears a black coat with a foldable hood, zipper slightly open revealing an acorn tucked inside, an old bag strap across the chest, and sneakers with double-layered soles. Accessories include a stack of thin telegraph papers on the shoulder and a small lightbulb device on the wrist. Calm, ageless, and neutral facial expression. Minimalist and functional aesthetic, steampunk-transition era influence, high quality, precise silhouette, no extra background objects.
